rationale.density: Melody onsets per beat provide a relative density direction before calibration to the runtime range.
rationale.syncopation: Off-beat vocal-note onsets provide a relative syncopation direction before calibration.
rationale.upwardContour: Signed melodic interval direction provides a relative contour direction before calibration.
rationale.pitchRange: Vocal range in semitones provides a relative range direction before calibration.
rationale.sustain: Average notated vocal duration provides a relative sustain direction before calibration.
rationale.harmonicMotion: Roman-numeral changes per measure provide a relative harmonic-activity direction before calibration.
rationale.brightness: Median vocal register and major/minor context provide a relative brightness direction before calibration.
rationale.tension: Altered, diminished, augmented, and secondary harmony share provides a relative tension direction before calibration.
rationale.closure: Final tonic/dominant evidence provides a relative closure direction before calibration.
rationale.dynamicContrast: The notated dynamic-mark range provides a relative contrast direction before calibration.
